Lasooni chaap – 3/5. I’ve had better chaap before; this one wasn’t very soft and leaned slightly on the sweeter side, which didn’t work for me.

Papdi paneer cheese shot – 1/5. This was recommended by the staff but turned out to be quite disappointing. It was deep-fried yet soggy instead of crispy, which ruined the texture completely.

Pyaaz and garlic kulcha – 4/5. This was the highlight of the meal. The stuffing was flavorful, and it tasted great. It comes with chole, which complemented it well.

Overall, an okay experience—not bad, but not something I’d specifically go back for.

featured_reviews.name: Abbasali Sorangwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
After trying idli sambar, dahi wada, veg pulao, veg cheese sandwich, and Chinese fried rice over multiple visits, I feel this place is better suited for chai and conversations rather than actual dining.

What disappointed me most was the consistency in poor food quality. I gave the idli sambar two chances on two consecutive weeks, hoping the first experience was just a bad day, but unfortunately, it was the same both times. At ₹70, the idli itself felt poorly prepared, and the sambar had a strange sharp taste, almost acidic, as if too much soda had been added. Instead of feeling satisfying, it actually left me with indigestion after both visits.

Pricing would still be acceptable if the quality matched, but that simply was not the case here. Expensive food is understandable, disappointing food at premium prices is not.

Good spot for chai and hanging out, but if you care about food quality and value, I would avoid coming here for dinner.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely Delightful Experience at NEO WELCOME!

We had an amazing time dining at NEO WELCOME. We tried the Mysore Masala Cheese Dosa, and it was simply wow — crispy, flavorful, and cheesy in the best way possible. The Schezwan Fried Rice was tasty and generous in portion, perfect for sharing.

We also tried their Cold Coffee, which was slightly on the sweeter side but still refreshing and enjoyable. The Paneer Paratha and Sada Butter Cheese Dosa were equally satisfying and lived up to the expectations.

What really stood out, apart from the great food, was the excellent service. The staff were very attentive — one of the waiters was constantly going around refilling cold water glasses the moment they were empty. Such thoughtful service is rare and truly appreciated.

Located just outside the station, it’s super convenient to get to. Overall, a fantastic veg restaurant with great food, top-notch service, and a welcoming vibe. Highly recommended and a must-visit!
